- pr-review-toolkit:code-reviewer: Use this agent when you need to review code for adherence to project guidelines, style guides, and best practices. It will check for style violations, potential issues, and ensure code follows the established patterns in CLAUDE.md. Also the agent needs to know which files to focus on for the review. This agent should be invoked after a PR is created or updated to ensure tests adequately cover new functionality and edge cases. See "When to invoke" in the agent body for worked scenarios. (Tools: All tools)

This agent should be invoked proactively after completing a logical chunk of work that involves error handling, catch blocks, fallback logic, or any code that could potentially suppress errors. 2	
3	## 목적
4	RealWorld 도메인(User, Follow, Article, Tag, Comment, Favorite)을 Prisma 스키마로 정의하고 SQLite 마이그레이션을 생성한다. 이후 모든 라우트/뷰 태스크가 이 모델과 Prisma Client 타입에 의존한다.

15	Prisma Client가 아래 모델·필드·관계를 노출한다. 라우트는 `app.prisma.<model>` 형태로 접근한다.

18	User      : id, email(@unique), username(@unique), password, bio(String?), image(String?), createdAt, updatedAt
19	            관계: articles, comments, favorites, following(Follow[]), followedBy(Follow[])

24	Comment   : id, body, articleId, authorId, createdAt, updatedAt   (article onDelete: Cascade)
25	Favorite  : id, userId, articleId                @@unique([userId, articleId])  (article onDelete: Cascade)
26	```
27	
28	## 구현
29	
30	### Step 1: `prisma/schema.prisma` 작성
31	```prisma
32	generator client {
33	  provider = "prisma-client-js"
34	}
35	
36	datasource db {
37	  provider = "sqlite"
38	  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
39	}

43	  email     String   @unique

47	  image     String?
48	  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
49	  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
50

52	  comments   Comment[]
53	  favorites  Favorite[]
54	  following  Follow[]   @relation("Follower")
55	  followedBy Follow[]   @relation("Following")
56	}
57	
58	model Follow {
59	  id          Int  @id @default(autoincrement())
60	  follower    User @relation("Follower", fields: [followerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
61	  followerId  Int
62	  following   User @relation("Following", fields: [followingId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
63	  followingId Int
64	
65	  @@unique([followerId, followingId])
66	}
67	
68	model Article {
69	  id          Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
70	  slug        String   @unique
71	  title       String
72	  description String
73	  body        String
74	  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
75	  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
76	
77	  author      User       @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
78	  authorId    Int
79	  tags        Tag[]      @relation("ArticleTags")
80	  comments    Comment[]
81	  favoritedBy Favorite[]
82	}
83	
84	model Tag {

86	  name     String    @unique
87	  articles Article[] @relation("ArticleTags")
88	}
89

91	  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
92	  body      String
93	  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
94	  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
95	
96	  article   Article @relation(fields: [articleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
97	  articleId Int
98	  author    User    @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
99	  authorId  Int
100	}
101	
102	model Favorite {
103	  id        Int     @id @default(autoincrement())
104	  user      User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
105	  userId    Int
106	  article   Article @relation(fields: [articleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
107	  articleId Int
108	
109	  @@unique([userId, articleId])
110	}
111	```

# Task 02: Prisma 스키마 & 마이그레이션

## 목적
RealWorld 도메인(User, Follow, Article, Tag, Comment, Favorite)을 Prisma 스키마로 정의하고 SQLite 마이그레이션을 생성한다. 이후 모든 라우트/뷰 태스크가 이 모델과 Prisma Client 타입에 의존한다.

## 선행 태스크
- **T01**: `package.json`(prisma/@prisma/client 의존성, `prisma:generate` 스크립트), `.env`(`DATABASE_URL="file:./dev.db"`).

## 구현 범위 / 대상 파일
- Create: `prisma/schema.prisma`
- Create: `prisma/migrations/**` (마이그레이션 생성 결과)
- Modify: `package.json` — `postinstall`에 `prisma generate` 추가(선택), 이미 있으면 생략

## 이 태스크가 확립하는 인터페이스 (후행 태스크가 의존)
Prisma Client가 아래 모델·필드·관계를 노출한다. 라우트는 `app.prisma.<model>` 형태로 접근한다.

```
User      : id, email(@unique), username(@unique), password, bio(String?), image(String?), createdAt, updatedAt
            관계: articles, comments, favorites, following(Follow[]), followedBy(Follow[])
Follow    : id, followerId, followingId          @@unique([followerId, followingId])
Article   : id, slug(@unique), title, description, body, authorId, createdAt, updatedAt
            관계: author(User), tags(Tag[] "ArticleTags"), comments(Comment[]), favoritedBy(Favorite[])
Tag       : id, name(@unique)                    관계: articles(Article[] "ArticleTags")
Comment   : id, body, articleId, authorId, createdAt, updatedAt   (article onDelete: Cascade)
Favorite  : id, userId, articleId                @@unique([userId, articleId])  (article onDelete: Cascade)
```

## 구현

### Step 1: `prisma/schema.prisma` 작성
```prisma
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model User {
  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  email     String   @unique
  username  String   @unique
  password  String
  bio       String?
  image     String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  articles   Article[]
  comments   Comment[]
  favorites  Favorite[]
  following  Follow[]   @relation("Follower")
  followedBy Follow[]   @relation("Following")
}

model Follow {
  id          Int  @id @default(autoincrement())
  follower    User @relation("Follower", fields: [followerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  followerId  Int
  following   User @relation("Following", fields: [followingId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  followingId Int

  @@unique([followerId, followingId])
}

model Article {
  id          Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  slug        String   @unique
  title       String
  description String
  body        String
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  author      User       @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  authorId    Int
  tags        Tag[]      @relation("ArticleTags")
  comments    Comment[]
  favoritedBy Favorite[]
}

model Tag {
  id       Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  name     String    @unique
  articles Article[] @relation("ArticleTags")
}

model Comment {
  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  body      String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  article   Article @relation(fields: [articleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  articleId Int
  author    User    @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  authorId  Int
}

model Favorite {
  id        Int     @id @default(autoincrement())
  user      User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  userId    Int
  article   Article @relation(fields: [articleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  articleId Int

  @@unique([userId, articleId])
}
```

### Step 2: 마이그레이션 생성 및 적용
```bash
npx prisma migrate dev --name init
```
기대: `prisma/migrations/<timestamp>_init/migration.sql` 생성, `dev.db` 생성, Prisma Client 생성 완료.

### Step 3: 스키마 검증 (스모크)
```bash
npx prisma validate
```
기대: `The schema at prisma/schema.prisma is valid 🚀`

### Step 4: Client 생성 확인 테스트 — `tests/schema.test.ts`
```ts
import { afterAll, expect, test } from 'vitest'
import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client'

const prisma = new PrismaClient()
afterAll(async () => { await prisma.$disconnect() })

test('can create and read a user', async () => {
  const email = `t${Date.now()}@x.io`
  const user = await prisma.user.create({
    data: { email, username: `u${Date.now()}`, password: 'hash' },
  })
  const found = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: user.id } })
  expect(found?.email).toBe(email)
  await prisma.user.delete({ where: { id: user.id } })
})
```

### Step 5: 테스트 실행
```bash
npm test -- schema
```
기대: 통과.

### Step 6: 커밋
```bash
git add -A && git commit -m "feat: add prisma schema and initial migration"
```

- `npx prisma validate` 통과.
- `prisma/migrations/`에 `init` 마이그레이션이 존재하고 `dev.db`가 생성된다.
- `tests/schema.test.ts`가 통과(User 생성/조회/삭제 가능).
